root_cause.text: The omap-dma probe function fails to destroy the dma_pool resource (allocated via dma_pool_create) when dma_async_device_register() or of_dma_controller_register() fails, causing a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `dma_pool_destroy(od->desc_pool);` in both error paths where those registration calls fail, directly addressing the missing cleanup. The commit message explicitly states that the dma_pool is not destroyed in those error paths.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak by destroying the descriptor DMA pool on probe failure when LL123 is supported.
intent_record.what: Added two lines inside the error path of omap_dma_probe: if od->ll123_supported is true, call dma_pool_destroy(od->desc_pool) before omap_dma_free(od).
intent_record.how: Ensures the DMA descriptor pool allocated when LL123 is supported is properly freed on probe failure, preventing a memory leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing cleanup of the DMA descriptor pool in the error path of omap_dma_probe to avoid a memory leak.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional call to dma_pool_destroy(od->desc_pool) if od->ll123_supported is true, before omap_dma_free(od) in the registration failure path of omap_dma_probe.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the descriptor pool allocated during probe is properly freed when DMA controller registration fails, preventing a resource leak.
